plugins.name: clear-not-compact
plugins.description: DEPRECATED. Superseded by built-in auto-compaction and 1M-token context. Kept installable so existing installs do not break. /handoff distills a session to a durable doc on disk; /resume reads it back into a fresh context.

plugins.name: autonomous-workflows
plugins.description: Autonomous, evidence-driven workflows. /factory builds an approved spec into an MVP unattended, ten agents at once with an adversary pass on every diff; /remediate self-drives a test-verified fix loop; /harden-repos fans out one agent per repo; /mine-provenance audits your portfolio against ground-truth artifacts. /fleet-health audits every local repo and ships only after a yes; /tdd-loop is a bounded red-green loop with adversarial review; /batch-run checkpoints a writer-plus-verifier fan-out per unit.
